lines: That tree has been shaped by one wind for about forty years.

Everything on this street leans the same way, including the people.

6:30 and the tar is already considering melting.
The weather gods are showing off.

The sea is that flat about nine mornings a year and this is one of them.

Days like this should come with a soundtrack.
The type of day that makes people text 'lekker dag hey'.

Full sun, soft lawn, and homework has officially lost its audience.
